description:
Rank Warsaw neighborhoods for a workplace: median rent, commute minutes, value score (rent vs typical rent in the same
commute band, like the map), monthly_cost (rent + commute valued at the minimum wage) and Pareto flag (no neighborhood both faster and cheaper)
(ranking osiedli: czynsz, dojazd, wartosc, front Pareto). Same data and rules as the map: neighborhoods with fewer than 20 ads are skipped. Sorted by best (rent + commute cost, the map's order) unless sort is given.

max_rent.description: Max neighborhood median rent (PLN, or PLN/m2 if measure=per_m2)
max_rent.title: Max Rent

rooms.description: Rooms 1-4 (4 = 4+); omit for any / liczba pokoi
rooms.title: Rooms

sort.description: best = rent + commute valued at the minimum wage (default, the map's order, total measure only); value = score vs typical rent in the same commute band; commute = fastest first; rent = cheapest first
sort.title: Sort

name: rank_neighborhoods
